_about: Walter Leaf (1852-1927): Troy, a Study in Homeric Geography (London: Macmillan, 1912) and Homer and History (Macmillan, 1915), raw IA OCR. His Iliad with Lang and Myers (PG 3059) is on the lang shelf. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted. A Companion to the Iliad for English Readers (1892), a book-by-book commentary keyed to the Lang-Leaf-Myers prose translation; and his Iliad, edited with apparatus criticus, prolegomena, notes and appendices, second edition (Macmillan, 2 vols., 1900-1902), Greek text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling; all raw IA.
